Paragraph:
Translation: Sanjaya said: O King, after looking over the army gathered by the sons of Pandu, King Duryodhana went to his teacher and began to speak the following words.

Purport (Excerpt): Sanjaya therefore informed the King that his son, Duryodhana, after seeing the military force of the Pandavas, at once went to the commander-in-chief, Dronacarya, to inform him of the real position... But Duryodhana's diplomatic veneer could not disguise the fear he felt when he saw the military arrangement of the Pandavas.
Situation/Problem_Faced: King Duryodhana surveys the formidable military formation of the Pandava army and is struck by internal fear regarding the seriousness of the impending battle.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Despite his fear, Duryodhana maintains a diplomatic exterior. He immediately approaches his teacher and commander-in-chief, Dronacarya, to discuss the reality of the situation and mask his insecurity with political maneuvering.
Outcome/Resolution: Duryodhana initiates a conversation with his commander, setting up his attempt to politically manage his internal anxiety and strategize against the opposing forces.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.ego: Facade, Masking, Defense mechanism, Diplomatic veneer

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Bhaya (Fear arising from a foundation of adharma or unrighteousness)
Ajnana (Spiritual blindness; being overly identified with material power and politics)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Sanjaya reveals the spiritual weakness inherent in the Kaurava camp. Although Duryodhana holds the title of king and possesses a massive army, his lack of alignment with dharma leaves him vulnerable to deep existential fear when confronting righteous forces.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Duryodhana demonstrates a classic psychological defense mechanism. Confronted with a threatening reality (the Pandava army) that triggers intense anxiety, he employs a 'diplomatic veneer' to mask his vulnerability. By rushing to an authority figure (Dronacarya) under the guise of political strategy, he attempts to regain a sense of control and soothe his underlying insecurity.
